name: breadcrumb
useFor: Use Breadcrumb at the top of a page that sits inside a hierarchy (a workspace, a repository, a pull request), or for a single back link (All posts). Use the default slash, or pass a CaretRightIcon as the separator's child. Link items with BreadcrumbLink (asChild or render for a router link) and end with BreadcrumbPage.
constraints: A link on the current page
An arrow that moves on hover
source: The Hoplite website's blog post back link (.bp-back: All posts) and the product window's crumb (.pa-crumb, .pa-crumb__project, .pa-crumb__sep)

examples.content:
import { ArrowLeftIcon, CaretRightIcon, FolderSimpleIcon } from "@phosphor-icons/react/ssr";

import { Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbEllipsis, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbLink, BreadcrumbList, BreadcrumbPage, BreadcrumbSeparator } from "@/components/ui/breadcrumb";

export function Preview() {
  return (
    <Breadcrumb>
      <BreadcrumbList>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#">acme/web</BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#">Pull requests</BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbPage>Fix the null check in billing</BreadcrumbPage>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
      </BreadcrumbList>
    </Breadcrumb>
  );
}

export function Carets() {
  return (
    <Breadcrumb>
      <BreadcrumbList>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#">
            <FolderSimpleIcon />
            Automations
          </BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator>
          <CaretRightIcon />
        </BreadcrumbSeparator>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#">Sentry triage</BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator>
          <CaretRightIcon />
        </BreadcrumbSeparator>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbPage>Run 41</BreadcrumbPage>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
      </BreadcrumbList>
    </Breadcrumb>
  );
}

export function Collapsed() {
  return (
    <Breadcrumb>
      <BreadcrumbList>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#">Acme</BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbEllipsis />
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#">Sandboxes</BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbPage>sbx-7f3a</BreadcrumbPage>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
      </BreadcrumbList>
    </Breadcrumb>
  );
}

export function BackLink() {
  return (
    <Breadcrumb>
      <BreadcrumbList>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#">
            <ArrowLeftIcon />
            All posts
          </BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
      </BreadcrumbList>
    </Breadcrumb>
  );
}

title: Breadcrumb
description: A trail of pages: 14px links in the quiet gray that turn ink under the pointer, the current page in the ink at medium weight, a slate slash (or a caret) between them, and a three-dot glyph for folded pages.
